title: Dong Dong Dong
desc: The story follows Wu Anning, who cares for her mother with Alzheimer's for ten years. Her father left early saying 'I can't hold on'. She marries the gentle Liu Shengyuan, but after getting pregnant, discovers he has been transferring money to strangers for nearly a year. On Christmas Eve, he disappears. On Christmas morning, three debt collectors smash the door with hammers over a two-million debt. At the moment the door breaks, she kneels before her mother's wheelchair and says, 'Forgive me for not loving you' — in ten years of care, there is responsibility, pity, and habit, but not necessarily love. The opening nursery rhyme 'Do you hear me, Mom' and the closing door-smashing sound lock together, writing an honest dismantling of family affection by a caregiver: true reconciliation is allowing oneself to admit this.
